019package org.apache.bcel.generic;
020
021import org.apache.bcel.Const;
022import org.apache.bcel.ExceptionConst;
023
024/**
025 * PUTFIELD - Put field in object
026 *
027 * <PRE>
028 * Stack: ..., objectref, value -&gt; ...
029 * </PRE>
030 *
031 * OR
032 *
033 * <PRE>
034 * Stack: ..., objectref, value.word1, value.word2 -&gt; ...
035 * </PRE>
036 */
037public class PUTFIELD extends FieldInstruction implements PopInstruction, ExceptionThrower {
038
039    /**
040     * Empty constructor needed for Instruction.readInstruction. Not to be used otherwise.
041     */
042    PUTFIELD() {
043    }
044
045    public PUTFIELD(final int index) {
046        super(Const.PUTFIELD, index);
047    }
048
049    /**
050     * Call corresponding visitor method(s). The order is: Call visitor methods of implemented interfaces first, then call
051     * methods according to the class hierarchy in descending order, i.e., the most specific visitXXX() call comes last.
052     *
053     * @param v Visitor object
054     */
055    @Override
056    public void accept(final Visitor v) {
057        v.visitExceptionThrower(this);
058        v.visitStackConsumer(this);
059        v.visitPopInstruction(this);
060        v.visitTypedInstruction(this);
061        v.visitLoadClass(this);
062        v.visitCPInstruction(this);
063        v.visitFieldOrMethod(this);
064        v.visitFieldInstruction(this);
065        v.visitPUTFIELD(this);
066    }
067
068    @Override
069    public int consumeStack(final ConstantPoolGen cpg) {
070        return getFieldSize(cpg) + 1;
071    }
072
073    @Override
074    public Class<?>[] getExceptions() {
075        return ExceptionConst.createExceptions(ExceptionConst.EXCS.EXCS_FIELD_AND_METHOD_RESOLUTION, ExceptionConst.NULL_POINTER_EXCEPTION,
076            ExceptionConst.INCOMPATIBLE_CLASS_CHANGE_ERROR);
077    }
078}
